props.name: xCategories
props.label: xCategories
props.description:
Explicit X-axis category ordering. When omitted, unique `x`
values from the dataset are sorted alphabetically / numerically.

props.name: yCategories
props.label: yCategories
props.description:
Explicit Y-axis category ordering. When omitted, unique `y`
values from the dataset are sorted alphabetically / numerically.

props.name: colorRange
props.label: colorRange
props.description:
Two-stop colour range used to interpolate cell colour.
First entry = min value colour, second = max value colour.
Accepts intent tokens or raw CSS colour strings.
Default `['info', 'danger']`.

props.name: cellGap
props.label: cellGap
props.description: Gap between cells in SVG user units. Default `2`.

props.name: showLabel
props.label: showLabel
props.description:
Render the numeric value centred inside each cell when the
cell is wide/tall enough to accommodate it. Default `true`.

props.name: showAxis
props.label: showAxis
props.description:
Render X and Y axis category labels along the grid edges.
Default `true`.

props.name: showGradientLegend
props.label: showGradientLegend
props.description:
Gradient legend bar with min / max labels.
Default `true`.

props.name: legendPosition
props.label: legendPosition
props.description: Anchor of the gradient legend. Default `'bottom'`.

props.name: xAxisFormat
props.label: xAxisFormat
props.description:
X-axis category label formatter. Applied to each column label.
When omitted, the raw string / number is displayed.

props.name: yAxisFormat
props.label: yAxisFormat
props.description:
Y-axis / value formatter. Applied to row labels AND to
the min/max labels on the gradient legend.
When omitted, the raw number is displayed.

props.name: series
props.label: series
props.description: Data series — one or more. Empty array renders the `#empty` slot.

props.name: categories
props.label: categories
props.description:
X axis labels (for line/area/bar/column/radar). Length should
match the longest series; missing entries fall back to the
numeric index. Ignored for pie / donut / scatter.

props.name: title
props.label: title
props.description: Optional title rendered above the plotting area.

props.name: subtitle
props.label: subtitle
props.description: Optional subtitle rendered below the title.

props.name: showLegend
props.label: showLegend
props.description:
Toggle the legend block. Default `true`.

⛔ #545 — has **no effect** on `OrigamChartGauge`: a gauge is a
single-value visualisation (only `series[0].data[0]` is read, extra
series are ignored) with no legend markup in its template at all.
Passing it warns once in dev builds (see `useUnsupportedProp`)
instead of silently doing nothing — same treatment as `colorScheme`
on Bullet/Candlestick/Heatmap/Map (#426).

props.name: showTooltip
props.label: showTooltip
props.description:
Toggle the hover tooltip. Default `true`.

⛔ #545 — has **no effect** on `OrigamChartGauge`: no tooltip markup
exists in its template, and `IChartGaugeSlots` deliberately `Omit`s
the `tooltip` slot the base family would otherwise expose. Passing
it warns once in dev builds — same treatment as `colorScheme` (#426).

props.name: animated
props.label: animated
props.description:
Animate paths / bars / slices on first paint and on data
changes. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. Default `true`.

props.name: animationDuration
props.label: animationDuration
props.description: Animation duration in ms. Default `600`.

props.name: colorScheme
props.label: colorScheme
props.description:
Palette used when a series does not pin its own `color`.
Pass intent strings (cycled in order) or raw CSS colours.
Default cycles through the 8 origam intents.

⛔ #426 — has **no effect** on `OrigamChartBullet`,
`OrigamChartCandlestick`, `OrigamChartHeatmap`, `OrigamChartMap`:
each has its own colour model (uniform fill + range palette,
binary bullish/bearish, or continuous gradient) with no
per-series identity axis for a rotating palette to drive.
Passing it on those four warns once in dev builds (see
`useUnsupportedProp`) instead of silently doing nothing.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.label: aspectRatio
props.description:
CSS `aspect-ratio` shortcut (`'16/9'`, `'4/3'`, `'1/1'`…). When
set, overrides `height` and lets the chart breathe with the
container width.

props.name: margin
props.label: margin
props.description:
Global shorthand. `16` → `16px`; `"4"` → the `--origam-space---4`
design rung; `"8px 16px"` → block / inline; `true` → the legacy
`--marged` class.

props.name: marginTop
props.label: marginTop
props.description: Overrides `margin` and `marginBlock` for the top edge.

props.name: marginLeft
props.label: marginLeft
props.description: Overrides `margin` and `marginInline` for the left edge.

props.name: marginBottom
props.label: marginBottom
props.description: Overrides `margin` and `marginBlock` for the bottom edge.

props.name: marginRight
props.label: marginRight
props.description: Overrides `margin` and `marginInline` for the right edge.

props.name: marginBlock
props.label: marginBlock
props.description: Top + bottom. Overrides `margin`; beaten by `marginTop` / `marginBottom`.

props.name: marginInline
props.label: marginInline
props.description: Left + right. Overrides `margin`; beaten by `marginLeft` / `marginRight`.

props.name: padding
props.label: padding
props.description:
Global shorthand. `16` → `16px`; `"4"` → the `--origam-space---4`
design rung; `"8px 16px"` → block / inline; `true` → the legacy
`--padded` class.

props.name: paddingTop
props.label: paddingTop
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingBlock` for the top edge.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.label: paddingLeft
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingInline` for the left edge.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.label: paddingBottom
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingBlock` for the bottom edge.

props.name: paddingRight
props.label: paddingRight
props.description: Overrides `padding` and `paddingInline` for the right edge.

props.name: paddingBlock
props.label: paddingBlock
props.description: Top + bottom. Overrides `padding`; beaten by `paddingTop` / `paddingBottom`.

props.name: paddingInline
props.label: paddingInline
props.description: Left + right. Overrides `padding`; beaten by `paddingLeft` / `paddingRight`.

props.name: rounded
props.label: rounded
props.description:
Corner-radius selector. Three modes:
 - **named variant** (`'small' | 'default' | 'large' | …`,
   cf. `ROUNDED` enum) → emits `--rounded-{name}` class so the
   component's SCSS can pick the right token rung.
 - **boolean `true`** (or empty string `''`) → emits the legacy
   `--rounded` class for components that only have a single rounded
   state (e.g. `OrigamBtn` defaulting to `radius.2xl`).
 - **CSS value** (`'4px'`, `'4px 0 4px 0'`, `100`) → emits inline
   `border-radius` declarations via `useRounded.roundedStyles`.

props.name: roundedTopRight
props.label: roundedTopRight
props.description:
Top-right corner only. Takes the same vocabulary as `rounded`
(`8`, `'8px'`, `'md'`, `'large'`, `'var(…)'`), minus `shaped` /
`shaped-invert` which are asymmetric by definition.

props.name: roundedTopLeft
props.label: roundedTopLeft
props.description: Top-left corner only. Same vocabulary as `roundedTopRight`.

props.name: roundedBottomLeft
props.label: roundedBottomLeft
props.description: Bottom-left corner only. Same vocabulary as `roundedTopRight`.

props.name: roundedBottomRight
props.label: roundedBottomRight
props.description: Bottom-right corner only. Same vocabulary as `roundedTopRight`.

props.name: fontSize
props.label: fontSize
props.description:
Font size token. Maps to `--origam-font__size---{fontSize}`
(xs · sm · md · lg · xl · 2xl · 3xl · 4xl · 5xl).
When unset, the component keeps its theme / density font-size.

props.name: fontWeight
props.label: fontWeight
props.description:
Font weight token. Maps to `--origam-font__weight---{fontWeight}`
(regular 400 · medium 500 · semibold 600 · bold 700 · extrabold 800 · black 900).
When unset, the component keeps its theme font-weight.

slots.name: tooltip
slots.label: tooltip
slots.slotPropsType: { point: IChartPoint; color: string; xLabel: string; yLabel: string; value: number; }
slots.description:
Replace the tooltip body for a hovered cell.
Receives the hovered point, its resolved colour, and
the formatted x / y / value strings.

slots.name: empty
slots.label: empty
slots.description: Render when `series` is empty / every series is hidden.
